description_en: Queries the top N applications in Application Monitoring
description_zh: 调用GetArmsTopNMetric接口获取应用监控的Top N应用列表
kebab_example: aliyun sae get-arms-topn-metric --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --order-by count --limit 10 --start-time 1675823135951 --end-time 1675824035951 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetArmsTopNMetric

parameters.help_en: The field based on which you want to sort the returned entries
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return. Valid values: 0 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，根据查询返回字段中的某个字段排序
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query
parameters.help_zh: 返回数据条数，取值范围[0,100]
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The SAE application type. Valid values:

micro_service
web
job
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The CPU allocation policy. Valid values:

request: CPU cores are allocated only when a request is initiated.
always: Fixed CPU cores are always allocated
parameters.help_zh:
SAE应用类型。

micro_service。
web。
job
parameters.name: app_source

parameters.help_en:
The additional information that is returned. The following limits are imposed on the ID:

success: If the call is successful, success is returned.
An error code: If the call fails, an error code is returned
parameters.help_zh:
CPU分配策略。

request：仅在有请求时分配CPU。
always：始终分配固定CPU
parameters.name: cpu_strategy

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code. The following limits are imposed on the ID:

2xx: The call was successful.
3xx: The call was redirected.
4xx: The call failed.
5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

Rt.description_en: The average response time. Unit: milliseconds

Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the list of applications was obtained. The following limits are imposed on the ID:

true: The namespaces were obtained.
false: no
Success.description_zh:
获取应用列表。取值说明如下：

true：获取成功。
false：获取失败
